list.title: controllers
list.description: Backend controllers

list.title: controllers.api.entity
list.description: Namespace to separate APIs controllers

list.title: controllers.api.entity.deleteEntity
list.description: The function `deleteEntity` deletes an entity from a database and updates related widgets and alarmsaccordingly.

list.title: controllers.api.entity.getEntities
list.description: The function `getEntities` retrieves entities from a database based on a client ID provided in therequest query parameters.

list.title: controllers.api.entity.getEntityById
list.description: The function `getEntityById` retrieves an entity from a database based on the provided entity ID andhandles error responses accordingly.

list.title: controllers.api.entity.insertEntities
list.description: The function `insertEntities` inserts entity data into a database table and returns the insertedentity's details along with a generated token.

list.title: controllers.api.entity.updateEntity
list.description: The function `updateEntity` updates entity data in a database table based on the provided requestbody parameters.

list.title: controllers.api.otp
list.description: Namespace to separate APIs controllers

list.title: controllers.api.widget
list.description: Namespace to separate APIs widgets controllers

list.title: controllers.api.widget.deleteWidget
list.description: The function `deleteWidget` deletes a widget from a database based on the provided widget ID andreturns appropriate messages based on the outcome.

list.title: controllers.api.widget.getWidgetById
list.description: The function `getWidgetById` retrieves a widget from the database based on the provided widget_idand returns the result or an error message.

list.title: controllers.api.widget.getWidgets
list.description: The function `getWidgets` retrieves all widgets from a database and sends the results as a JSONresponse, handling any errors that occur during the database query.

list.title: controllers.api.widget.getWidgetsWithEntities
list.description: The function `getWidgetsWithEntities` retrieves widgets with associated entities based on client anddashboard IDs, enhancing the results with additional configuration data before returning them asJSON.

list.title: controllers.api.widget.insertWidget
list.description: The function `insertWidget` is an asynchronous function that inserts a new widget into a databasetable and returns a success message or an error message.

list.title: controllers.api.widget.updateWidget
list.description: The function `updateWidget` updates a widget in a database table based on the provided parametersand returns a success message or an error message.

list.title: controllers.mail
list.description: Espacio de nombres para las funciones de la API dentro de los controladores.

list.title: controllers.mail.sendOtpEmail
list.description: The function `sendOtpEmail` sends an email with a two-step login code using an HTML template.

list.title: controllers.mqtt
list.description: Espacio de nombres para las funciones de la API dentro de los controladores.

list.title: controllers.mqtt.checkAlarmCondition
list.description: Checks if the alarm conditions are met based on the received data.

list.title: controllers.mqtt.isValidToken
list.description: Token validation logic - Replace with actual logic as needed.

list.title: controllers.mqtt.publishMessage
list.description: Publishes a message to the MQTT broker after validating token existence.

list.title: emitMqttMessage
list.description: The function `emitMqttMessage` emits a MQTT message through Socket.IO and logs the message to theconsole if Socket.IO is initialized.

list.title: generateOtp
list.description: The function `generateOtp` generates a one-time password (OTP) using the speakeasy library, storesit in a database with an expiration time, and returns the OTP.

list.title: generateToken
list.description: The function `generateToken` asynchronously generates a random 16-byte token in hexadecimal format.

list.title: getAlarmsByDevice
list.description: Retrieves alarms associated with a specific device and client from the database.

list.title: getEntities
list.description: The function `getEntities` asynchronously retrieves all entities from a database table using aparameterized query.

list.title: getToken
list.description: This function retrieves a token from a database based on the provided client_id and device_id.

list.title: getWidgetsByEntityId
list.description: The function `getWidgetsByEntityId` retrieves widgets based on entity_id and client_id from adatabase asynchronously.

list.title: init
list.description: The `init` function initializes a socket.io connection by setting the `io` variable to the provided`socketIo` parameter.

list.title: saveAlarmNotification
list.description: Saves a notification into the database when an alarm is triggered.

list.title: saveMessage
list.description: The function `saveMessage` saves a message with specified parameters into a database table called`historial`.

list.title: subscribeToDevices
list.description: Subscribes to all MQTT device topics based on entities fetched from the database.Validates token before subscription.

list.title: verifyOtpInDatabase
list.description: The function `verifyOtpInDatabase` checks if a given OTP is valid and unused in a database for aspecific client ID.
